topography.project_purpose: This brief describes the observed EVM deployment and audit surface for Parallel Protocol. It intentionally limits the description to receipted repository and on-chain evidence instead of inferring a business model.
topography.relationship_narrative: The pinned logic-topography run contains 143 contract row(s) across arbitrum, avalanche, base, berachain, bsc, ethereum, fraxtal, gnosis, hyperliquid, ink, linea, optimism, plasma, polygon, scroll, sei, sonic, unichain. Structural roles: 71 unclassified, 59 supporting, 13 core. 5 row(s) use upgradeable patterns.
